rationale: The upgrade page describes TLS 1.0/1.1 removal and recommends TLS 1.2 or higher. The TLS configuration guide documents default-off and a temporary legacy opt-in, requires restart and warns of known vulnerabilities. The existing source-register repair preserves both sections. No universal protocol eligibility is inferred.

exclusions: No unlisted exact pairing, rollout, entitlement or customer authorization established.
